text: Implemented fixed-seed dense/sparse and memory/block benchmark scenarios, Rprofmem allocation telemetry, native processx/ps child peak-RSS polling, aggregate worker schema, and CSV evidence. Live runs completed. Measured incremental peaks were 475136, 9699328, and 8994816 bytes versus plans 159260, 1941020, and 1741340; all coverage flags are FALSE, so the later parallel gate remains closed.
